{"code": "import numpy as np

# Replace -999.0 with NaN in both baseline and final biomarker columns
data['biomarker_baseline'] = data['biomarker_baseline'].replace(-999.0, np.nan)
data['biomarker_final'] = data['biomarker_final'].replace(-999.0, np.nan)

# Check how many missing values are now in each column
missing_baseline = data['biomarker_baseline'].isnull().sum()
missing_final = data['biomarker_final'].isnull().sum()

missing_baseline, missing_final"}
